title: F1 regulation periods 2010-2026: raw, sourced data for the physics and sound model of F1Drive

conventions.fact: every figure is an object: { v, unit?, src: [source ids], note? } for a sourced value; { v, est: true, basis, src? } for an estimate; { v: null, unknown: true, note } when it could not be established; { derived: true, from } for values computed from other facts of this file
conventions.mass: minimum weight = car with driver, dry tyres, no fuel (regulation). qualifyingMass = minimum + 5 kg fuel (assumption); raceMidMass = minimum + half the race fuel
conventions.power: powerPeak = best-supported estimate of the peak total output (combustion + electric) of the front-running power unit in qualifying trim; powerRaceTrim = estimated power available through most of the full-throttle part of a lap (combustion plus the electric power that the energy rules let the car sustain there: KERS 2011-2013 only 6.7 s a lap, ERS-K 120 kW almost the whole full-throttle time 2014-2025, 2026 capped by the 8.5 MJ/lap recharge limit); powerCombustionRaceTrim = the combustion share of it; powerReported = figures quoted by Wikipedia for single power units, most of them tagged "unreliable source" there and 10-15 % above the official FIA / Formula 1 / Mercedes statements, kept for reference only; hp = kW / 0.7457
conventions.lapTimeAnchors: v / ms = final lap of the fastest classified qualifier (F1DB); best / bestMs = fastest lap of the whole qualifying session; cond / bestCond = dry | mixed | wet; anchorMs = the lap to calibrate against (best dry lap on the comparable layout) or null
conventions.cockpit: gameStyle follows js/README-interfaces.md: modern (2010-2017, no halo), halo (2018-2021), halo18 (2022 on)
conventions.label: seasons[year].label = the game's display text for that one year, used instead of the period's label where the period label names a change of a later year (the year selector shows "<year> · <label>"); a plain string like cockpit
